about: km's one set of candidate, baseline, reference files and program hashes (../REGISTRATION_DRAFT.md, Amendment 1 (Sept 30), (b) item 3: 'The runner and the reader use this set and no other'). run_km.sh, km_check.py, footprint_km.py and read_km.py read this file through km_config.py, which checks it; nothing else names a build, a baseline or a reference file. The values the committed amendment fixes (the codes, kt_build, official_engine, the counter tool, the eight reference files) are also constants in km_config.py, which refuses any other value; the values left to set are the cloud's. A null value is required and not known yet (the cloud reports it with B's round): every script refuses to run until it is set. From part I on, <out>/km_inputs.sha256 (the one list, (b) item 4) pins this file's bytes and the set it names.

comparison.note: km3 = kta3 + N2 at B; kta3 = kog3 + kt's switch 1 as ec7e1a8 defines it (EvalFeatures::KTA), the adopted working pilot. Amendment 1 (b) items 1-2, (d) item 2.

build.commit_note: REQUIRED: B, the cloud's new build commit, 40 hex digits (BUILD.md in round_folder names it). Every output file name starts with its first 7 characters. Its engine/ differs from kt_build's in engine/src/players/ only, engine/UPSTREAM.md aside (Amendment 1 (c) item 2, (e) item 1: git diff ec7e1a8 B -- engine/ ':!engine/UPSTREAM.md'; UPSTREAM.md is a notes file no build reads and stays as the branch has it).
build.branch_note: the cloud branch B and its round are committed on; confirm it when the cloud reports B (part B checks that B and round_head are on it).
build.round_head_note: REQUIRED: the commit that completes B's round (BUILD.md, STATUS.txt, the km3 smoke and the tool tests' outputs committed as passed); B is its ancestor. The cloud outputs below are read from it.
build.round_folder_note: REQUIRED: rl/results/km_build_<date of B> (Amendment 1 (c) item 3: a new folder, never the Sept 29 one).
build.kt_build_note: ec7e1a8, the kt build: kog-based kt/kta/ktb/ktc (players/mod.rs:197-207 there); the reference files below were played by the laptop's programs built from it. B's engine/ diff from it must touch engine/src/players/ only, engine/UPSTREAM.md aside. Fixed by the amendment: km_config.py refuses any other value.
build.official_engine_note: 233bced, the official engine's code (rl/engine-2026-09-28/); its kta<N> is the OLD kp-based preset, never run for km (Amendment 1 (d) item 4). Checked: B's engine/ diff from it is players/ only too, engine/UPSTREAM.md aside. Fixed by the amendment: km_config.py refuses any other value.

counter_tool.note: the counter tool's source in B's tree must have this sha256 (Amendment 1 (e) item 2); built as an example in B's engine/.

cloud_outputs.note: B's round, committed at round_head under round_folder (Amendment 1 (c) item 3; (e) item 3). REQUIRED, set when the cloud reports them.

km3_smoke.note: the km3 smoke at B, both sides, table pairings 0, 2 and 19, i < 40 (120 games): the laptop's km3 reference (identity 7; (e) item 3)

cloud_outputs.tool_test1_note: test 1's stdout and --games-out sha256 as B's STATUS.txt records them (kp3, 560 games)

references.note: kta3's committed games at ec7e1a8, kta3 on both sides in every row (Amendment 1 (b) item 3). Each group: the file, its sha256, its pairings, deals i < deals, seed seed_base + pairing x 10,000 + i, even i puts the first-named deck in seat 0; decks from 'pairs' (null: legality_scan's --decks table).

played_by.note: the laptop's ec7e1a8 programs (kta_tables_2026-09-29/STATUS.txt, line 2): provenance only; they play no km game (Amendment 1 (d) item 3)

programs.note: the laptop's sha256 of its deckgym, examples/legality_scan and examples/tool_census built from B: run_km.sh part B writes them to <out>/programs.txt and to its 'KM PART B DONE' line in <out>/STATUS.txt before the first game ((e) items 3 and 5); every later part checks the programs against them before its first game and after its last, and read_km.py checks programs.txt, the STATUS line and the programs on the disk.
